verdict.rationale: Gazebo's own documentation shows that user worlds and models live in SDFormat files, which users edit directly and launch with `gz sim shapes.sdf`. SDF snippets can be copied out of Gazebo Fuel model pages, and the standalone sdformat library and Fuel client and CLI tools let that data be parsed and retrieved outside the simulator. That gives meaningful portability, but there is no documented 'export all my data' path. missing for 10: an explicit export-everything workflow, documentation of exporting simulation outputs (logs and sensor data) in open formats, a documented bulk download of Fuel assets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
